title: Payday loans - federal and state boundary
facts: Payday lending is heavily affected by state law; states differ on whether payday loans are permitted and on rate, fee, amount, rollover and licensing restrictions.

Federal consumer-finance laws can apply to disclosures, electronic payments, military borrowers and unfair or deceptive practices without creating one nationwide payday-loan price cap for all consumers.
A specific payday-loan legality or maximum-cost answer requires the borrower's state and the lender or product type.
